name: Grilled Tempeh Tacos with Spicy Tomato-Cilantro Salsa & Lettuce
instructions: Place oil and spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine the spice paste.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, slice tempeh crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the spice paste and turn to coat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add the tempeh and grill until browned and crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Add oil, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with tempeh, salsa, and lettuce. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
